bluf: Found is a London search and performance agency of 90+ marketing experts, a 2026 Google Premier Partner selling SEO, AI search visibility and PPC as three lead lines under an Everysearch™ identity. Its case book is led by bookings and leads for hospitality and travel names. The Horus read is Favored (+12), best placed for KJ1, most exposed to KJ6. A rival should know 3 of 6 house tests fail: it sells paid social with no social pixel, LinkedIn advertising with no LinkedIn ads of its own, and CRO with no testing tool on its homepage, and its Luminr platform shows no audited citation figure in the record.
doing:
The positioning line, an AI first Everysearch™ agency optimising how brands appear across every searchable platform, from Google and TikTok to Amazon and AI answers, decodes as: a search agency that has renamed search to cover every box a buyer types into and sells the tracking of it. The headline claim stacks credentials rather than results: Google Premier Partner with 100+ awards and nominations, including Standout PPC Agency of the Year.

The sold mix runs 12 lines, from SEO, AI SEO and GEO through PPC, paid social and programmatic to digital PR and content, influencer, data and AI, strategy, creative and CRO. Three lead lines score 3: AI Search / GEO (Luminr backed AI SEO, AEO, LLM, Claude and Perplexity SEO pages), Paid Search (Premier Partner; a Newmarket Holidays ROAS case) and SEO (technical, ecommerce, international, local, SaaS and migration pages). Four core lines score 2: CRO (the Clermont case lifted conversion rate 203% and bookings 205%), Content & Digital PR (digital PR, consumer PR and reputation management pages), Data & Measurement (data science, analytics and tag management; a Clermont data and AI case) and Paid Social (paid social and Meta advertising pages). Proprietary items listed: Everysearch™, Luminr and a PPC Keyword Tool; the one partner listed is Google Premier Partner (2026).

AI posture in plain terms: it brands itself AI first and sells AI SEO, AEO, GEO and LLM visibility tracked in Luminr; the Horus move read still marks P1 partial, because no audited product (tracking, scorecard, citation share) shows in the record. The only move on the record is undated: the nav lists a Found New York presence with no opening date. The record lists no pricing signals. Conspicuously absent for a performance agency of its size: no founding date or owner, no news or jobs in the deep record, no owned audience or CRM line, and no web build capability.
clients:
Found serves a mixed book in ecommerce, hospitality, travel, B2B, financial and professional services, SaaS, fintech and luxury, from London, with New York listed.

The record holds 20 clients, 11 with an observed need and 9 names only. The mix reads paid performance first (N2, share 0.261), then local and lead generation (N10, 0.24), organic demand (N1, 0.199) and PR and content (N12, 0.145). The signals: The Clermont Hotel came for leads and web (205% Increase in Bookings with CRO); Newmarket Holidays for organic, leads and AI (Driving Bookings with AI-Led Search); Hoxton for leads and paid (90% Increase in Bookings with Meta Advertising); Roomex for leads and paid (65% Increase in Leads with PPC); Funky Pigeon for paid (210% Increase in Sales with PPC); Fender for paid and brand (8.9M Impressions with Paid Media); House of Marley for paid and social (22.3M Audience Reach with Paid Social); Randstad for PR and paid (59+ Links with Digital PR); YHA for PR and brand (1.3M Video Impressions with Content Marketing); Mahlkönig for organic and PR (+194% Blog Growth); Trust Payments for organic (38% Increase in Sessions with SEO).

Names only: 1st Central, Toolstation, EDF Energy, Champneys, Blackhawk Network, Clarks Originals, Bonmarché, Taylor & Francis and Vita Student, need inferred from search and paid media.

Shared: EDF Energy also sits on the books of netpeak and search-laboratory, Randstad on eskimoz, and Funky Pigeon on impression.

What the base needs next: the Horus read ties it to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) as tailwinds and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) as the headwind. It is likely, moderate confidence, that the bookings and leads names next buy citation tracking and ads inside assistants, the product Luminr is positioned to sell.
house: Say and do: 3 of 6 tested lines are practised on its own house. Corroborated: AI Search / GEO (it publishes llms.txt and its sitemap holds 27 AI topic URLs), Paid Search (it runs its own Google ads, 14 in the Transparency Center, 8 in the last 30 days, advertiser Found Group Limited, last shown 2026-09-27) and Publishing cadence (60 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days, 141 in 365, of 802 listed). Contradicted: Paid Social (it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site), LinkedIn advertising (it sells paid social or B2B demand gen and runs no LinkedIn ads of its own; the ad library returns 0 for the company) and CRO (it sells CRO and no testing tool is detected on its homepage). No AI crawlers are blocked. Tag stack gtm, hubspot, hotjar and cookiebot; CMS WordPress; no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack detected. Meta and TikTok: no record.
market:
The Horus read gives a tailwind index of 11.5, band Favored, verdict Favored (+12). Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.304), driven by AI Search / GEO (+2) and Paid Search (+1) against SEO (-1), and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers, net 0.228). Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out, net -0.176), driven by Paid Search, SEO and Paid Social at -1 each, and KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer, net -0.114). Best scenario fit: The Walled Oasis (35/100). Moves: making P2 and P4, partial on P1, absent on P3, P6, P7 and P8, unknown on P5.

The Monsoon read gives index 55.5, band Onshore wind, observed. Migration 56.5 edges displacement 54.5: hours and price sensitivity sit level. SEO (12) and Paid Search (8) carry the most movable hours. No hub office is listed, so the footprint is inferred, with a shore split of 65% South and Southeast Asia, 20% Eastern Europe and 15% Africa and the Maghreb.
openings: It is very likely (high confidence) that the three house contradictions are the lead: it sells paid social with no social pixel on its own site, LinkedIn advertising with no LinkedIn ads of its own, and CRO with no testing tool on its homepage; a rival that runs all three on its own house wins the comparison in the room. The falsifier is a social pixel, a LinkedIn campaign or a testing tool appearing on found.co.uk at the next compile. It is likely (moderate confidence) that the AI visibility claim is contestable on proof: it names Luminr, but the read marks P1 partial because no audited citation share, scorecard or tracking shows in the record, so a rival with the audited number leads with it, and P8 is absent. It is likely (moderate confidence) that a transparent, outcome priced offer undercuts it, since the record lists no pricing model. EDF Energy (netpeak, search-laboratory), Randstad (eskimoz) and Funky Pigeon (impression) already buy from other tracked agencies and are the contestable names. It is unlikely that offshore price alone moves the book, with displacement 54.5 and a mixed icp.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures (late October 2026): growth below 10% flags cannibalization of its SEO and PPC lead lines, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility (late October 2026): US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend (rolling): the next $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM set the economics of ads inside assistants, where P8 is absent for Found.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures (October 2026): output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would deepen the KJ6 exposure on its SEO and paid search hours.

Follow up the undated Found New York presence for an opening date, and the Clermont and Newmarket Holidays cases last modified 2026-08-31 for any Luminr citation share figure, which would move P1 to making.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as that date.
